messages.subject: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm looking to rent a plate compactor - do you have one available at the Kempele depot?

Thanks,
Minna Ojanperä

messages.subject: Deposit refund - RB-20265093
messages.body:
Hello,

Booking RB-20265093, the 10m scissor lift. I returned it five days late, I realise, but I'd like to get the full deposit of 150 EUR refunded. I've rented from you many times over the years and my previous deposit question was sorted in my favour when it turned out the equipment was at fault. I'd appreciate the same kind of resolution here.

Esko Väyrynen

messages.subject: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Afternoon,

Any chance you have a diamond floor saw we can book? We've got a slab cutting job lined up and need one fairly soon.

Regards,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi,

I'll check our availability for the diamond floor saw and get back to you.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Petri,

Before we confirm the booking, we wanted to ask about pricing. We've been a loyal account customer for years and have done plenty of rentals with you. Would a 22% discount be possible on this one?

Regards,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Returning the scissor lift
messages.body:
The 10m scissor lift is finished on our site and we need to arrange the return. Can we bring it to you directly or should we schedule a collection?

Thanks,
Rakennus Piispanen Oy

messages.subject: Invoice question - mini dumper
messages.body:
We received the invoice for the 1-tonne mini dumper rental and had a question about it. Is this the right address for billing queries?

Regards,
Kiinteistöhuolto Ahola Oy

messages.subject: Pressure washer
messages.body:
Hi there,

Quick one - do you have a petrol pressure washer we can book for a site cleanup?

Thanks,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer
messages.body:
Got it. Let me check what we have and I'll come back to you.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer
messages.body:
Petri,

While I'm at it - we also need a site cabin (single unit) for the same project. What are the delivery options for that?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Morning,

We need to book a 20kVA diesel generator and want it delivered to our site in Oulu. What options do you have for delivery?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for getting in touch. I'll look into delivery scheduling for the 20kVA unit and let you know what we can do.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Marko,

Separate matter - booking RB-20265951, the 1-tonne mini dumper. We returned it late because our driver got stuck in traffic on the way back to the depot. The 300 EUR late return fee doesn't seem fair given the circumstances. Can that be waived?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy
